statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2) having exactly227 actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets counted once, let r_T count those containing actual triangle T and put d_T=6-r_T. All deficiencies are zero, one, two or three. If a,b,c count deficiency-one, deficiency-two and deficiency-three triangles, respectively, then a+2b+3c=24 and precisely the following necessary population ranges hold: c=0 with 1<=b<=8 and a=24-2b; c=1 with 0<=b<=5 and a=21-2b; or c=2 with b in {0,1} and a=18-2b. No c>=3 occurs. This does not assert realizability of a listed population, exclude count227 or resolve the target.
assumptions: R=227 counts actual induced9-vertex rook subsets once by their vertex sets
r_T counts those actual subsets containing T; local defect edges mean no induced rook contains both intersecting actual triangles

scope.description: Universal conditional sixteen-row necessary population restriction at R227. Actual point labels, arbitrary other target edges and the parity of deficiency-one plus deficiency-three triangles are retained. No equitability, automorphism or faithful collapsed-defect-cycle-to-square assumption.

dependency_reason: Only strict D>=6m+6 and nonempty maximum>=2 are inherited. Local defect degrees, odd-family parity, point-fan incidence bound, target upper Gram, disjoint-triangle matching cap, even-six induced rook and outside-one-neighbor equality are reconstructed in the paper. Previous R228 papers and the regular-set audit are overlap/comparison sources, not approval gates for this new statement.

exact_constraints.point_parity: r1+r3 even; no r1-only parity when c>0

c1_b6_saturation.contradiction: At each saturated outerpoint unique degree-one C would need defect edges to both degree-two partners.

c0_b9_rook_equality.D2_shared_outer_vertex_forbidden: Would give two distinct rook roots adjacent to the same outside vertex.
c0_b9_rook_equality.outerpoint_contradiction: The sole positive local node has degree two and no possible positive partner.

proof_route: D24 and inherited strict bound give maxd3; nonempty maximum>=2.
Local handshake gives even r1+r3; actual fan geometry gives P>=3r1+5r2+7r3.
For c>=2 local degree feasibility forces D3 pairwise disjoint and a degree-three star at each of their points.
D1 incidences and PSD indicator energy exclude c3/4 after incidence caps c<=4.
At c2 actual crossmatching caps D1 bridges by3, forcing b<=1.
At c1,b>=3 local stars give nine D1 partners; b6 saturates six external D2 and violates C degree one.
At c0 parity and outer mass leave b<=9; b9 gives an even-six induced rook.
Full-coordinate rook Gram equality, independently also CN plus90 boundary edges, forces one rook neighbor on every outside point.
Nine rooted D2 triangles cannot share outerpoints, leaving impossible local degree two and rejecting b9.
hand_boundaries: Valid common-point star degrees3,1,1,1 has r1 odd and r1+r3 even.
Valid common-point graph degrees3,2,2,1 reaches c1b2 fan weight20 and remains permitted.
Common-point degrees3,3,1,1 are impossible in a simple local graph.
Disjoint actual triangles may have a three-edge crossmatching; cap3 is retained.
Target rook Gram equality applies to all99 coordinates, not only to the9 internal coordinates.
The rook9 graph alone is not a target extension and does not satisfy the target ambient Gram premise.
No ordinary local collapsed defect fourcycle is silently identified with an actual square.
limitations: R227 is not excluded; sixteen necessary rows are not asserted realizable.
Target resolution and scientific coverage remain UNKNOWN.
No full defect graph classification, census or future execution gate is produced.
Bounded Markdown comparison is not a whole-archive or worldwide novelty proof.
